description:
dev/studies/6c7fcb38/receipts.md section 15 states the archived work budget 'is stated for q = 5; no q = 7 work budget is committed' and declines to apply one, while the archived calibration names a q=7 budget of 3.5e8 (dev/archive/ae82bd73-gf2-algebra-permanent/plans/b293af5a/r4_gpu_uniformity_resample.md:225-227) and the runtime qualification tabulates it exceeded 3.07x without fault (dev/studies/a9284086/receipt.md sections 9.1-9.2, 10.2). The archived source settles the disagreement against the receipts. Found during the 0dffa759 synthesis and recorded there as finding F.4.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The section-15 premise is corrected to cite the committed q=7 budget with its source, every rendering of the no-committed-budget claim in dev/studies/6c7fcb38/ is swept, and the correction preserves the section's verdict where it still follows; a verdict the correction changes is recorded with the change per @/inv/falsification-preserved.
- [hard] REQ-02: The receipts' analysis script still reproduces every rendered figure after the edit, and no measurement artifact is modified.
title: F_7 receipts deny the committed q=7 work budget the archived calibration states
